dev-top.sql: SELECT repo, stars FROM repositories ORDER BY stars DESC, repo ASC LIMIT 3

dev-null.sql: SELECT repo FROM repositories WHERE license IS NULL ORDER BY repo

dev-zero.sql: SELECT repo, forks FROM repositories WHERE stars = 0 ORDER BY repo

dev-owner-totals.sql: SELECT owner, COUNT(*) AS repo_count, SUM(stars) AS total_stars FROM repositories GROUP BY owner ORDER BY owner

dev-average.sql: SELECT repo, stars FROM repositories WHERE stars > (SELECT AVG(stars) FROM repositories) ORDER BY stars DESC, repo ASC

dev-quotes.sql: SELECT repo, description FROM repositories WHERE description LIKE '%''%' ORDER BY repo

dev-missing-owner.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM repositories WHERE owner = 'delta'

dev-tied-winners.sql: SELECT owner, repo, stars FROM repositories r WHERE stars = (SELECT MAX(stars) FROM repositories m WHERE m.owner = r.owner) ORDER BY owner, repo

dev-license-groups.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN license IS NULL THEN 'unlicensed' ELSE license END AS label, COUNT(*) AS repo_count FROM repositories GROUP BY label ORDER BY label

dev-share.sql: SELECT repo, COALESCE(ROUND(stars * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(stars) FROM repositories), 0), 2), 0.0) AS pct FROM repositories ORDER BY repo
